Description
32.15Bullion Trading LLC presents: 1 Kilo Silver Bar Valcambi
Product Details
Dive deep into the world of precious metals with the 1-kilo Silver Bar Valcambi, a symbol of elegance and a testament to superior craftsmanship. Specially priced at just $4.19 per oz over the spot, this bar stands out as an exceptional choice for both seasoned investors and newcomers.
Bar Highlights:
Content:
Contains 1 kilo (32.15 oz) of .999 fine Silver, offering a significant addition to any bullion collection.
Packaging:
Each bar is meticulously wrapped in plastic, preserving its unique poured design.
Design:
The obverse boasts the renowned Valcambi logo, accentuated by details of weight and purity. The reverse remains blank, keeping the design simple yet profound.
Quality Assurance:
The promise of Valcambi resonates with each bar, guaranteeing its quality and purity.
Specifications
Crafted with precision, these bars radiate the quality of .999 fine Silver. Originating from Valcambi, a name with a legacy spanning over 50 years in Switzerland, every piece tells a story of excellence in bullion production.
History
Valcambi’s rich history dates back over half a century in Switzerland, a testimony to their relentless pursuit of perfection in the world of precious metals. This 1 kilo Silver bar is a contemporary product of that legacy.
